newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli diamond industry requests government aid.
newsitem.headline: Israeli diamond industry requests government aid.

text.p: Israel's diamond cutters have requested government aid to buy equipment to allow them to compete against other diamond centres, the Industry and Trade Ministry said on Monday.

The machinery would enable the industry to reduce its high labour costs, which put it at a disadvantage compared with other centres, industry officials told Dov Mishor, the ministry's director-general.

They said they were seeking refunds of value added tax on Israeli-made equipment, financial assistance for the purchase of equipment, and help in procuring research, development and marketing funds from the ministry.
